newsitem.title: USA: Arafat says Netanyahu also his peace "partner".
newsitem.headline: Arafat says Netanyahu also his peace "partner".

text.p: Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat said on Tuesday he considers Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu his peace "partner" just as previous Israeli leaders were.

Asked at a National Press Club appearance whether he considered Netanyahu a partner, a term he often uses to describe the late Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin, or an "opponent," Arafat replied: "My partner. I have to respect what the Israelis have elected ... We are making the peace with the Israeli people. He is now my partner, as Rabin was my partner, as Shimon Peres was my partner, now my partner is Mr. Netanyahu."
